Dropdown.setup was 102. setupPopover (the menu is a popover and most of what it
needs is only knowable at open time - position depends on whether this dropdown
has a parent, classes on whether it renders as a bottom sheet - so the options are
getters) and setupTargetBinding (the toggle is whatever the caller put in the
default slot, so the classes and listeners that make it a toggle are applied to
the element rather than declared in a template).

AutoComplete.setup was 109. setupInputDebounce, setupDismissal, and
setupPresentation - and that last name is the finding: dropdown and inline are not
variants of one presentation, they are two. As a dropdown the list is a positioned
menu that opens on demand; inline it is always open and loads its sources once at
setup. That was an if/else at the bottom of setup with no name on either branch.

CustomColorPicker.setup was 101. setupDragListeners and publishCallbacks, plus
reachableDocuments for the frame walk. The listener loop now says WHY it iterates
documents - the website editor renders the site in an iframe and a drag that
crosses into it must keep working, which is the same reason getLocalPoint walks
frameElement rects - and the two call-site .bind(this) calls are gone, because
useExternalListener already binds to the component.
